attempt_history.note: The combined process produced no complete JUnit and is not counted. Seven fresh interpreter runs passed 606 and skipped 5.

conclusion: The four ZeRO factories now consume fresh child-produced training state through an opt-in harness callback and independently validate it. The other 57 training factories retain their existing generic refusal; this package makes no blanket runtime claim for them.

hook_repairs.finding: The stacked [world_size, shard_size] input aborted ProcessGroupGloo.
hook_repairs.repair: Use the reduce_scatter_tensor concatenation form, accepted by Gloo and NCCL.
Use synchronous reduce-scatter/all-gather only when the explicitly selected backend is Gloo; NCCL retains the asynchronous future path.

implementation.callback: TorchrunLaunchSpec.result_callback is unset by default. Only Zero2TorchrunBenchmark sets it; the harness invokes it only after return code zero.
implementation.freshness: Parent-injected wall-clock and monotonic launch tokens are repeated by each child. The callback requires child start, finish, artifact mtime and callback finish to fall in the same launch window.
implementation.independent_reference: The parent constructs the seven-linear GELU network directly with torch.nn.functional.linear/GELU from raw initial parameters and runs an independent dense torch.optim.AdamW over the rank-averaged deterministic inputs. It does not call the production model builder or training step.
implementation.post_timing_verification: The fixed small FP32 correctness profile uses production DDP, communication-hook and optimizer construction after the normal measured region. A separate verification_training_step keeps capture and deterministic-input work out of the timed training_step.
implementation.quorum: Exactly rank-0..rank-(world_size-1) JSON and tensor files are accepted; missing, extra and temporary files fail.
state_coverage: resolved mode, variant, world size, backend, device and optimizer config
wrapper seed and before/after CPU or CUDA RNG-state hashes
update count and nonzero parameter/gradient/optimizer-state checks
implementation.transport: Each rank atomically fsyncs and renames a tensor payload, then atomically publishes a JSON manifest containing payload size and SHA-256.

limitations: The full repository suite is outside this package receipt and must be rerun against the integrated tree.
The one targeted skip is the genuine two-rank CUDA/NCCL gate.
GPU custody, clock locking, default workload execution and performance comparison remain external runtime gates.

claims_not_made: default large-shape memory or performance qualification
performance_and_runtime_boundary.gloo: Verification-only. The direct child prints that no performance timing was collected; no Gloo number is populated or accepted.
performance_and_runtime_boundary.nccl: The normal scripts still require CUDA/NCCL, preserve the existing workload/default dimensions/clock path and use asynchronous collectives. No NCCL or GPU run occurred in this package.
performance_and_runtime_boundary.timing: The child result profile runs after training_seconds and throughput are calculated and printed; parent process-wall timing still includes setup/profile and remains separately labeled by the existing harness.

scope: Functional completion slice for W1-004, W1-091 and LOCAL-019 across the four ZeRO factories.
